title: TTGO T-Display S3 (1.9 inch 8-bit LCD)
description: In this example the LilyGO/TTGO T-Display-S3 draws an illustrative dashboard with the Pulsar IoT logo, readings and a live chart on its built-in 1.9 inch colour LCD. The screen uses an 8-bit parallel bus, fast enough to animate the chart, bars and status light at about 25 frames a second.
author: Steven Slaa
